
# Build directory layout
#
# CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR/
# - nimble/
#   - (nimble packages...)
# - nimcache/
#   - (nim compiler output...)
#   - tbb.hxx                     (generated by interop.nim)
#   - tbb_nim.h                   (generated by Nim compiler)
# - libbackend.a|backend.lib
# - backendLinkTest|backendLinkTest.exe
# - backendTest|backendTest.exe
#

project(backend C)

# Nim should use the same compiler as cmake
if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
  set(NIM_CC "vcc")
elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
  set(NIM_CC "gcc")
elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  # Clang or AppleClang
  set(NIM_CC "clang")
else ()
  # unknown compiler family, might want to abort here
  # or provide your own compiler config (see nim.cfg)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "unknown compiler, manual configuration required")
endif ()

find_package(Nim REQUIRED)
set(NIMBLE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nimble")
set(NIMCACHE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nimcache")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${NIMCACHE_DIR}")

set(NIM_ARGS "")
list(APPEND NIM_ARGS "--cc:${NIM_CC}")
list(APPEND NIM_ARGS "--nimcache:${NIMCACHE_DIR}")
list(APPEND NIM_ARGS "--NimblePath:${NIMBLE_DIR}/pkgs2")
if (NOT DEBUG_BUILD)
  list(APPEND NIM_ARGS "-d:release")
endif ()

# Setup dependencies from nimble file
message(STATUS "Running nimble install")
execute_process(
  COMMAND "${NIMBLE}" -y --nimbleDir:${NIMBLE_DIR} install -d
  WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS backend.nimble)

function (nim_project targetName projectFile outFile)
  set(dummy "${outFile}.dummy")
  add_custom_target(
    ${targetName}
    DEPENDS "${dummy}"
    COMMENT "Compiling Nim Target ${targetName}"
  )
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${dummy}" "${outFile}"
    COMMAND "${NIM}" ${NIM_ARGS} -o:"${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${outFile}" cpp "${projectFile}"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    COMMENT "Compiling Nim Output ${outFile}"
  )
endfunction ()


set(LIB "${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}backend${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
nim_project(backendTarget lib/lib.nim "${LIB}")

add_library(backend STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
add_dependencies(backend backendTarget)
set_target_properties(backend PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${LIB}")
target_include_directories(backend INTERFACE 
  "${NIMCACHE_DIR}"
  "include"
)

if (BUILD_TESTING)

  set(TESTER "backendTest${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}")
  nim_project(backendTestTarget test/test.nim ${TESTER})
  add_executable(backendTest IMPORTED GLOBAL)
  add_dependencies(backendTest backendTestTarget)
  set_target_properties(backendTest PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${TESTER}")

  add_executable(backendLinkTest "test/linkTest.cxx")
  target_link_libraries(backendLinkTest PRIVATE backend)

  enable_testing()
  add_test(NAME backendTest COMMAND backendTest)
  add_test(NAME backendLinkTest COMMAND backendLinkTest)

endif ()
